sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT I OF 1973
ACT I OF 1973
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE EHTRAM-E-RAMAZAN ACT, 1972
An Act to provide
for prohibition of eating, drinking or smoking in public places during fasting
hours in the month of 'Ramazan'
[Gazette of N.-W.
F. P., Extraordinary, 12th January 1973]
No. Legis. 1 (39)/72.-The
following Act of the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province,
having been assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province, on
the 12th January 1973, is hereby published for general information-
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.-(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province
'Ehtram-e-Ramazan' Act, 1972.
(2) It extends to the whole of
the North-West Frontier Province, except the Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Definitions

2. Definitions.-In this
Act, unless the context otherwise requires; the following expressions shall
have the meanings hereby respectively assigned to them, that is to say--
(a) "Government" means
the Government of the North-West Frontier Province;
(b) "public place"
includes any house, room, tent, enclosure, vehicle, vessel, road, lane, bridge,
square or any other place, to which the public have access.

Ban on eating, etc., in public places

ACT I OF 1973
ACT I OF 1973
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE EHTRAM-E-RAMAZAN ACT, 1972
An Act to provide
for prohibition of eating, drinking or smoking in public places during fasting
hours in the month of 'Ramazan'
[Gazette of N.-W.
F. P., Extraordinary, 12th January 1973]
No. Legis. 1 (39)/72.-The
following Act of the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province,
having been assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province, on
the 12th January 1973, is hereby published for general information-
3. Ban on eating, etc., in
public places.-If any person, who according to Islamic tenets is under
obligation to fast, is found eating, drinking or smoking in a public place
during fasting hours in the month of 'Ramazan', he shall be punished with
simple imprisonment which may extend to three months or with fine which may
extend to five hundred rupees or with both.

Ban on serving In public places

ACT I OF 1973

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE EHTRAM-E-RAMAZAN ACT, 1972
An Act to provide
for prohibition of eating, drinking or smoking in public places during fasting
hours in the month of 'Ramazan'

No. Legis. 1 (39)/72.-The
following Act of the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province,
having been assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province, on
the 12th January 1973, is hereby published for general information-
4. Ban on serving In public
places.---If any keeper of a hotel, restaurant or canteen offers or serves
or causes to be offered or served any eatables, during fasting hours in the
month of 'Ramazan', to any person who according to Islamic tenets is under
obligation to fast, he shall be punished with simple imprisonment which may
extend to three months or with fine which may extend to five hundred rupees or
with both.

Power to enter and arrest

ACT I OF 1973
ACT I OF 1973
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE EHTRAM-E-RAMAZAN ACT, 1972
An Act to provide
for prohibition of eating, drinking or smoking in public places during fasting
hours in the month of 'Ramazan'
[Gazette of N.-W.
F. P., Extraordinary, 12th January 1973]
No. Legis. 1 (39)/72.-The
following Act of the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province,
having been assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province, on
the 12th January 1973, is hereby published for general information-
5. Power to enter and
arrest.---(1) If any District Magistrate, a Magistrate of the First Class
or any Police Officer not below the rank of a Sub-Inspector has reason to
believe that any offence under this Act has been, is being or is about to be
committed, he may enter any public place and arrest any person who, in his
opinion, has committed, is committing or is about to commit such offence.
(2) It shall be the duty of the
officer arresting any person under subsection (1) to release such person on
bail of sufficient bail be tendered for his appearance before a Police Officer
or before a Magistrate, as the case may be, and shall make a report of the
circumstances under which the arrest was made to the nearest Police Station.
(3) When any person is arrested
under subsection (1) the person arresting him shall, if sufficient bail is not
tendered, forward him to the nearest Police Station, with a report of the
circumstances under which such arrest was made.

6. Cognizance of offences.---No
Court shall take cognizance of any offence under this Act except on the
complaint in writing made by the officer-in-charge of the Police Station in
whose jurisdiction the offence is alleged to have been committed.

Repeal and saving

ACT I OF 1973

following Act of the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province,

8. Repeal and saving.---(1)
The North-West Frontier Province 'Ehtaram-e-Ramazan, Ordinance, 1972, is hereby
repealed.
(2) Notwithstanding the repeal of
the North-West Frontier Province 'Ehtram-e-Ramazan' Ordinance, 1972, everything
done or action taken, jurisdiction or powers conferred, rules made, order
issued, proceeding instituted, sentence passed, or fine imposed under any of
the provisions of the said, Ordinance, shall if not inconsistent with the
provisions of this Act, be continued, and so far as may be, be deemed to have
been respectively done, taken, conferred, made, issued, instituted, passed or
imposed under this Act.
